title: Utilizing DataStorage Use Limits
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: This official lesson documents DataStorage byte limits, credit budgets, accumulation rules, and request costs creators must account for in released Worlds.

sections.title: Limits
items: Names, keys, tags, versions, update values, and set values have documented UTF-8 byte limits.
FunctionGroups differ in credits paid per minute, accumulated credits, and credits consumed per request.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Creator Center lesson on 2026-07-27.
steps: Check every name, key, tag, version, and value against the documented byte limit.
Budget credit consumption for expected traffic.
Test the released World under realistic request volume.
